name: Ardmor Country House

tagline.en: A Fáilte Ireland 4-star country house in An Spidéal, with some of the best reviews in the village.
tagline.ga: Teach tuaithe 4 réalta Fáilte Ireland sa Spidéal, le cuid de na léirmheasanna is fearr sa sráidbhaile.

en: Welcome to our family-run B&B in the heart of Connemara. We look forward to helping you make the most of your stay, from the best walks and beaches to where to find music tonight.
Breakfast is cooked to order every morning, and book direct with us for our best price.
ga: Fáilte go dtí ár B&B teaghlaigh i gcroílár Chonamara. Táimid ag tnúth le cabhrú leat an leas is fearr a bhaint as do chuairt, ó na siúlóidí agus na tránna is fearr go dtí an áit le ceol a chloisteáil anocht.
Bíonn bricfeasta á réiteach gach maidin, agus cuir in áirithe linn go díreach chun an praghas is fearr a fháil.
